description: This file defines the 'AuthParams' class within the OrangeHRM authentication module, implementing credential and attribute bag handling for authentication processes.

classes.name: AuthParams
classes.description: Implements authentication parameter transfer object, encapsulating user credentials and authentication attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes AuthParams with given user credentials and optional attribute bag.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Returns a clone of the user's credentials.

methods.name: getAttributeBag
methods.description: Returns a clone of the authentication attribute bag.
